head: working-tree
subject: Owned background LRS runner
change: lrs.Runner now owns the LRS client and scheduler and runs the control-plane-aware report loop on a background task. create() establishes the initial LRS stream with a bounded connect timeout, start() spawns the loop, stop() sets a shutdown event and cancels the task, failureReason() exposes terminal failures, and deinit() joins and releases the client, scheduler and runner storage. The loop polls at poll_interval and relies on the scheduler's overall-deadline bound.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/lrs/runner_tests.zig 'gRPC LRS runner owns a background report loop' starts a real control plane, source channel and destination, waits for an interval report, asserts no terminal failure, and stops the runner cleanly.

notes: Applications can now run LRS automatically with lrs.Runner. Wiring the runner into the runtime Controller, authority-specific control planes, SDS/certificate providers and non-router filters remain open.
